cvs.missingClient: CVS was not found. Install a local CVS client and set JetTortoise: CVS Path.
cvs.workingCopy: Open a CVS working copy folder, then refresh.
cvs.cancelled: Operation cancelled. Refresh to check the working copy; CVS may have applied part of the operation.
cvs.timeout: CVS timed out. Refresh to check the working copy before retrying.
cvs.symlink: A symbolic link crosses the operation boundary. Use a working copy without symbolic links.
cvs.root: Unsupported CVS root. Use a local repository or pserver without an embedded password.
cvs.commitState: Some selected files cannot be committed. Refresh, resolve conflicts or update first.
cvs.changed: The file changed during rollback. Your file and its backup were preserved.
cvs.entriesLog: CVS recovery metadata is pending. Run CVS status in a terminal, then refresh.
cvs.outputLimit: The operation exceeded the output or working copy size limit. Use a smaller working copy.
cvs.command: CVS failed. Check repository access and working copy state in a terminal, then refresh.
cvs.dirty: Save or close unsaved editors in this working copy before modifying files.
